text: Glad to find this place! The doctor speaks decent English and has good knowledge on my child's symptoms. She's definitely showing signs of recovery after taking the prescribed meds. Total check up and medicines only cost us around 800 baht. Very reasonable! Highly recommend this place if your children got sick in Phuket. Thank you doctor

Went there to obtain a medical certificate to renew drivers license.  We did each other a favor 100THB and 4 minutes received what I needed and vice versa.  Good to note, that your apply for both a driver license and motorbike license you will need two certificates = 200thb.

text: We went with our daughter of 1,5 years old and the doctor was very kind, helpful and explained well in english. Would defenitely recommend him! We also immediately got the right medicines from him to take home.
Visiting the doctor in this clinic with any symptoms of our little one. Really happy to find this place with good quality at reasonable price.
I got a medical certificate for my driver's license here. A very kind and professional doctor! Thank you!

I don't know about other people's experiences, but my family went to the doctor on January 30th, 2026, for the first time. We usually go to our regular clinic for fevers, but we always get in line. They did a quick, superficial examination, not a thorough one. Today, February 1st, 2026, because the medication prescribed at the clinic caused several complications and my child became very lethargic, we took him to Vachira Hospital. The doctor at the hospital said he had received an overdose of medication; his potassium levels were abnormally high, much higher than for children his age, posing a significant danger and risk. I want to know if it's acceptable to prescribe medication indiscriminately, and if something happens to the child, who will take responsibility? (My child had a normal fever due to changing months, but now they need blood tests and X-rays to check various values.) I want to ask if someone will be able to take responsibility for any mistakes that may occur.

We were here in July 2023, but I forgot to leave a review then. We arrived with a child with a cough. The doctor prescribed a mucolytic for our daughter (she was only 11 months old at the time!!!), which is absolutely contraindicated in the first years of life and can cause serious complications. It's a shame we didn't know this then and managed to use the medication several times. Upon returning to Pattaya (where we were living at the time), we went to see our pediatrician, who told us the prescription was completely inappropriate.

Be vigilant, and if you do decide to see this doctor, double-check everything they prescribe!

Today I took my niece to the clinic for the first time. The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice. Importantly, the clinic opens at 8:30 AM, and the doctor was very punctual; we were able to see her as soon as it opened. I was very satisfied with the clinic's service and the doctor's examination. Truly impressed!

We're from out of town. My child was sick, and I found this clinic on Google. I initially called to inquire and was impressed with the doctor's answers and advice. The doctor was very attentive, thorough, and patient. Even on a weekday, there were many patients, including children, waiting in line. It seems like a trusted community clinic. The prices are reasonable, better than going to a hospital.
The doctor is very kind and gives excellent advice. I'm impressed every time I visit.

We were visiting Phuket and my son happened to be sick. We didn't want to go to the hospital because of the long wait times and high costs. We searched online and found this doctor's clinic with good reviews, so we decided to come see him. The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice. There was no waiting time, the clinic was clean and well-equipped, and the prices were reasonable. We were very impressed.
The doctor is kind and communicates well with children. The examination was thorough and didn't take long. The price was also reasonable.

I've taken my child to see the doctor three times now and he's gotten better every time. The doctor is very skilled, gives detailed advice, and provides excellent service. He always speaks politely. Thank you very much.
We treated our children for six months. The doctor is experienced, educated, and, of course, speaks good English. We thank our doctor👍👏👏👏 …

Great advice, effective medicine, and a truly skilled doctor. I've taken my daughter for treatment and she's always recovered. I've even gone with him when I had similar problems; he's genuinely talented.
I took my child to see Dr. Kamol... and they always recovered. The service was excellent!!!
